string.name: copy_number
string.comment: Menu action that copies a phone number to the clipboard.

string.name: create_new_contact
string.comment: Menu action that creates a contact from the selected phone number.

string.name: add_to_a_contact
string.comment: Menu action that adds the selected phone number to an existing contact.

string.name: send_message
string.comment: Menu action that starts a text message to the selected phone number.

string.name: edit_number_before_call
string.comment: Menu action that lets the user edit a phone number before calling it.

string.name: blockThisCaller
string.comment: Menu action that blocks calls and messages from the selected caller.

string.name: unblockThisCaller
string.comment: Menu action that removes the block from the selected caller.

string.name: delete
string.comment: Menu action that deletes the selected call-log entry.

string.name: anonymous
string.comment: Fallback caller name when the phone number is withheld.

string.name: placeholder_call_log
string.comment: Empty-state message shown when phone permission is required to display call history.

resources.string: 要查看通话记录，请开启电话权限

string.name: turn_on
string.comment: Button that opens settings to grant the permission required by the current screen.

string.name: outgoing_call
string.comment: Call-detail label identifying an outgoing call.

string.name: incoming_call
string.comment: Call-detail label identifying an answered incoming call.

string.name: missed_call
string.comment: Call-detail label identifying a missed incoming call.

string.name: rejected_call
string.comment: Call-detail label identifying an incoming call that was declined.

string.name: blocked_call
string.comment: Call-detail label identifying a call that was blocked.

string.name: blocked
string.comment: Call-detail subtitle identifying a blocked number.

string.name: voicemail_call
string.comment: Call-detail label identifying a voicemail entry.

string.name: voicemail
string.comment: Label for voicemail in navigation or call information.

string.name: block_confirmation_title
string.comment: Title of the block-caller confirmation dialog. %1$s is the caller name or phone number.

string.name: block_confirmation_message
string.comment: Explanation in the block-caller confirmation dialog.

resources.string: 你将不会再收到此号码的来电或短信。

string.name: more_options
string.comment: Accessibility label for a button that opens additional actions.

string.name: action_call
string.comment: Button that starts a phone call.

string.name: cancel
string.comment: Button that dismisses the current dialog without applying changes.

string.name: call_detail_contact_subtitle
string.comment: Contact phone type and number in the call-detail header. %1$s is the phone type and %2$s is the phone number.
